sections.title: NERN CONUS...GREAT LAKES TO OH VALLEY
sections.text: PREFRONTAL AIR MASS FCST TO DESTABILIZE CONSIDERABLY DURING AFTERNOON...AWAY FROM SHALLOW/COLD BOUNDARY LAYERS COVERING LM/LH. INLAND SFC DEW POINTS MID 60S TO MID 70S F AND POCKETS OF STG SFC HEATING WILL SUPPORT AREAS OF MLCAPE 2000-3000 J/KG...GENERALLY INCREASING WITH WWD EXTENT ACROSS OUTLOOK AREA. MEANWHILE...MID-UPPER LEVEL WINDS AND LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL INCREASE WITH NEWD EXTENT AHEAD OF MID-UPPER SHORTWAVE TROUGH. ACCORDINGLY...SCATTERED TSTMS FCST TO DEVELOP DURING AFTERNOON AHEAD OF FRONTAL ZONE...PRIMARILY INVOF SFC TROUGH/WIND-SHIFT LINES. ACTIVITY SHOULD EVOLVE INTO ONE OR TWO QLCS TYPE SYSTEMS AND MOVE ESEWD TO SEWD OVER LOWER MI...SRN ONT...LE...AND ADJACENT PORTIONS WRN NY...NWRN PA...OH AND NRN/ERN INDIANA. MAIN THREAT WILL BE DAMAGING WIND...WITH SECONDARY POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL PRIMARILY WITHIN FIRST 2-3 HOURS OF CONVECTIVE EPISODE. sections.title: CENTRAL/NRN PLAINS
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP OVER PORTIONS WRN SD AND WRN/CENTRAL NEB...INVOF SFC FRONTAL ZONE...BLACK HILLS...AND PERHAPS DRYLINE FCST NEAR WRN BORDERS OF SD/NEB. FCST VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES READILY SUPPORT SUPERCELL THREAT...ESPECIALLY INVOF FRONTAL ZONE WHERE RELATIVELY BACKED LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL ENLARGE 0-3 KM AGL HODOGRAPHS. STEEP LOW-MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ATOP NW-SE ALIGNED BOUNDARY LAYER MOIST AXIS WILL SUPPORT MLCAPE 1500-2500 J/KG OVER MUCH OF THIS REGION NEAR FRONT. HOTTER AND MORE DEEPLY MIXED AIR WILL EXIST SW OF FRONT...ALSO SUPPORTING HAIL/WIND THREAT. TORNADO POTENTIAL IS CONDITIONAL...AND MAINLY CONCENTRATED INVOF FRONTAL ZONE. ONE OR TWO CLUSTERS OF TSTMS MAY EVOLVE DURING EVENING AND OVERNIGHT FROM AFTERNOON ACTIVITY...AND/OR DEVELOP ANEW OVER PORTIONS NRN NEB INTO CENTRAL/ERN SD...WITH HAIL AND ISOLATED STG-SVR GUSTS BEING MAIN THREAT.

sections.text: SCATTERED TO WIDELY SCATTERED AFTERNOON TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP IN NARROW ZONE OF VERY MOIST AND STRONGLY HEATED BOUNDARY LAYER AIR OVER THIS REGION. sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: DOMINANT UPR RDG WILL REMAIN OVER THE SRN/CNTRL PLNS THROUGH FRI. IN THE WAKE OF AMPLIFYING TROUGH NOW OVER THE UPR GRT LKS...AND DOWNSTREAM FROM TROUGH NOW OVER BC/WA...EXPECT THE RDG TO TEMPORARILY BUILD N ACROSS THE NRN PLNS. ON THE IMMEDIATE NE SIDE OF THE RDG...WEAK IMPULSE THAT CROSSED THE DAKOTAS YESTERDAY IS NOW OVER IA. THIS FEATURE SHOULD TURN MORE SSE TODAY AND REACH THE LWR OH/LWR TN VLY TONIGHT. IN THE WEST...BC/WA TROUGH APPEARS TO HAVE DISLODGED LONG-LIVED LOW OFF THE SRN CA CST. THE CA LOW SHOULD MOVE ACROSS CNTRL/SRN CA LATER TODAY...AND SHEAR NE ACROSS THE GRT BASIN TONIGHT/EARLY FRI. WITH THE PRIMARY BELT OF THE WLYS REMAINING IN CANADA...FEATURES AT LWR LVLS WILL REMAIN FAIRLY WEAK ACROSS THE U.S. TWO DIFFUSE CONFLUENCE AXES ARE APPARENT ATTM OVER THE N CNTRL STATES... EXTENDING FROM SRN MN/IA/WI/NRN IL ENE INTO WRN QUEBEC. THESE FEATURES ARE LOOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH UPR GRT LKS UPR TROUGH AND SHOULD MOVE GENERALLY ESE THROUGH THE PERIOD. THE WRN PARTS OF THESE BOUNDARIES WILL REDEVELOP N AS A WEAK WARM FRONT ACROSS CNTRL NEB AND THE WRN DAKOTAS LATER TODAY AS A FAIRLY WELL-DEFINED FRONTAL SYSTEM EVOLVES OVER THE NRN RCKYS/NRN HI PLNS AHEAD OF BC/WA IMPULSE.

sections.title: WRN PARTS OF THE CNTRL PLNS
sections.text: LOW LVL WAA SHOULD INCREASE OVER WRN PARTS OF THE CNTRL/NRN PLNS LATER TODAY THROUGH TONIGHT AS WEAK WARM FRONT REDEVELOPS NWD AHEAD OF APPROACHING UPR TROUGH. THIS ACTIVITY MAY YIELD A CONTINUING THREAT FOR DMGG WIND AND POSSIBLY HAIL THROUGH EARLY FRI.

sections.title: CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS

LCL/LFC REMAIN RATHER HIGH ATTM BASED ON OBSERVED DEW POINT DEPRESSION AND MODIFIED UNR/LBF SOUNDINGS. MOST FAVORABLE DISCRETE SUPERCELL POTENTIAL WILL REMAIN ALONG AND E OF SFC FRONT...WHEN EFFECTIVE LIFTED PARCELS STILL ARE SFC-BASED AND RELATIVELY ELONGATED LOW LEVEL HODOGRAPHS BECOME MORE SO AS LLJ INTENSIFIES...UNTIL DIABATIC COOLING STRENGTHENS MLCINH SUBSTANTIALLY. REF WW 514 AND MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS IN THIS AREA. REF WW 511 AND ATTENDANT MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS. OVERALL SVR THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH IN ANOTHER 2-3 HOURS AS SFC COOLING STRENGTHENS SBCINH...AND LIFT ALONG OUTFLOWS DIMINISHES.
